minutes.headline: Planning Board approved stormwater permits for three Lemonster Rd/Kilburn St lots, a common driveway, and a shed; continued others.
minutes.summary: The Planning Board held several public hearings on 13 January 2025. It closed and approved stormwater permits for 791 and 795 Lemonster Road and 70 Kilburn Street, and for 171 Arbor Street (plus a common-driveway special permit). It also approved a shed modification at 230 Flat Hill Road. It continued 255 Sunny Hill Road, 494 Electric Ave and 558/560 Goodrich Street to January 27. It also heard committee reports and discussed the Master Plan Steering Committee quorum problem.

public_comment.topic: General public comment at the opening: none offered.
Asked whether 255 Sunny Hill Road is the same parcel as the earlier larger development, and whether drainage would harm the wetlands or wildlife.
Confirmed the same concern: that the driveway would be on Sunny Hill Road, not Lemonster Road.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing for the stormwater permit at 791 Lemonster Road.
Approve the stormwater permit for 791 Lemonster Road with standard conditions and deed recording of maintenance requirements.
Close the public hearing for 795 Lemonster Road.
Approve the stormwater permit for 795 Lemonster Road with standard conditions.
Close the public hearing for 70 Kilburn Street.
Approve 70 Kilburn Street stormwater permit as proposed with standard conditions.
Close public hearings for 171 Arbor Street (stormwater permit and common driveway special permit).
Approve the stormwater management permit for 171 Arbor Street with all standard conditions.
Approve the special permit for the common driveway at 171 Arbor Street with site plan standard conditions and a condition that a legal framework for shared maintenance be recorded on deeds.
Close the public hearing for 230 Flat Hill Road.
Approve modification to site plan approval and special permit for 230 Flat Hill Road as proposed with standard conditions.
Require submission of a peer review deposit from the applicant, assigned to Graves Engineering, for 255 Sunny Hill Road.
Continue the public hearing for the 255 Sunny Hill Road stormwater permit to January 27 at 6:05 p.m.
Continue public hearings for 494 Electric Ave and 558/560 Goodrich Street to January 27 at 6:05 p.m.
Approve minutes of October 28, 2024 and November 25, 2024.

budget_items.what_was_said: A board member questioned the cost to the applicant of three peer reviews on the related lots; the board defended peer review as standard and protective.

budget_items.topic: Peer review deposit, 255 Sunny Hill Road
budget_items.what_was_said: The board voted to require the applicant to submit a peer review deposit for Graves Engineering.

budget_items.topic: Cost of drainage failure to neighbors
budget_items.what_was_said: A member said a drainage problem could cost an abutting homeowner an ongoing yearly amount.
A member said there is no money in the town budget for peer review, so applicants fund it.

budget_items.topic: Past-due taxes at 255 Sunny Hill Road
budget_items.what_was_said: Staff noted the property has past-due taxes; any approval should require taxes paid in full before permits issue.
The capital planning committee submitted capital rankings this cycle and will next work on the long-range plan.
Staff described TIP as the main federal transportation funding pool; Lunenburg has had no projects in it in some years.
A member said the consultant for the town manager search was likely worth the cost given the small amount the town spent.

decisions.decision: Staff recommended, and the chair indicated the board would proceed with, the MBTA Communities zoning plan toward fall town meeting after public engagement despite the Supreme Court ruling.
A zoning workshop was set for January 27 to begin work on the ADU and floodplain bylaws for annual town meeting.
Staff will draft the 171 Arbor Street decision, with the standard conditions and HOA/maintenance condition, for review at the next meeting before signing.
The chair will put the Master Plan Steering Committee composition on the next agenda and the chair and staff will consult the Town Clerk on quorum.
The chair agreed to schedule a joint meeting with the Open Space Committee if they request one.
Next meetings: January 27 and February 10; February 17 is not a meeting night.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board approved stormwater permits for 791 and 795 Lemonster Road and 70 Kilburn Street after closing each public hearing.
It approved the stormwater permit and a common-driveway special permit for 171 Arbor Street, with a condition that a shared-maintenance framework be recorded on the deeds.
It approved a modification to the site plan and special permit for a shed at 230 Flat Hill Road.
It required a peer review deposit from the applicant at 255 Sunny Hill Road, then continued that hearing and two others (494 Electric Ave, 558/560 Goodrich Street) to January 27.
The chair will put Master Plan Steering Committee membership on the next agenda and consult the Town Clerk on quorum.

why_it_matters: Stormwater permits and peer review rules decide who pays to manage drainage: members said the town budget has no money for peer review, so applicants fund it, and a drainage failure can fall on abutting homeowners.
Conditions recorded on deeds, such as maintenance duties for shared driveways and drainage, pass to later owners of those properties.
The Master Plan Steering Committee's quorum problem could affect when the town's long-range planning work can proceed.
watch_next: January 27 at 6:05 p.m.: continued hearings for 255 Sunny Hill Road, 494 Electric Ave and 558/560 Goodrich Street, plus a zoning workshop on the ADU and floodplain bylaws.
The next meeting, where staff will bring the drafted 171 Arbor Street decision for review before signing.
